latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—introduces an agent-assisted protocol for making handbuilt, pit-fired pottery from local clay without commercial supplies or electricity.

- Agent researches your local clay, generates custom project plans, material lists, and firing schedules.
- Provides decision trees for troubleshooting cracks, leaks, and firing problems.
- Logs all progress, schedules reminders, and manages inventory and batch records using the filesystem.
- Physical pottery work (clay digging, forming, firing) is performed by the human; agent handles planning, record-keeping, and safety checklists.
- Includes protocols for testing clay, step-by-step building, pit construction, firing, testing, and repairs.
- Designed for resilient, zero-waste production of kitchenware, storage jars, and custom ceramic tools.
